picks.title: Uprising
picks.highlight: 雷鬼传奇1980年经典《Uprising》重制登场，《Redemption Song》依旧直击人心，夏日必听。
picks.highlightEn: Bob Marley's 1980 classic Uprising returns remastered — Redemption Song still lands like a prayer. Essential summer listening.
picks.summary: 雷鬼乐最重要的专辑之一，重制版保留了原作的根源律动与自由颂歌气质，全球听众超350万。
picks.summaryEn: One of reggae's most important records, remastered with its roots grooves and freedom anthems intact; over 3.5M listeners worldwide.

picks.title: The Stooges
picks.highlight: 1969年首张同名专辑重制，《I Wanna Be Your Dog》依旧原始生猛，朋克前传的起点。
picks.highlightEn: The 1969 debut remastered: I Wanna Be Your Dog still snarls. This is where punk begins.
picks.summary: 原型朋克的开山之作，粗糙失真与伊基·波普的狂野台风被完整保留，车库摇滚教科书。
picks.summaryEn: A founding text of proto-punk, preserving the raw distortion and Iggy's wild stage energy — a garage rock textbook.

picks.title: RE-FLOW
picks.highlight: ZB1全新迷你专辑《RE-FLOW》，九人声线在合成器与舞曲节拍间流动，主打舞台值得循环。
picks.highlightEn: ZEROBASEONE's new EP RE-FLOW: nine voices flowing through synths and dance beats — the title track begs for repeat plays.
picks.summary: 韩国新生代男团高完成度舞曲EP，旋律抓耳、编曲层次分明，是本周K-Pop代表。
picks.summaryEn: A polished dance-pop EP from Korea's rising boy group — hooky melodies and layered production, this week's K-pop pick.

picks.title: The Power Station
picks.highlight: 80年代超级组合经典重发：Duran Duran双Taylor与Robert Palmer联手，放克摇滚与华丽鼓点。
picks.highlightEn: The 80s supergroup reissued: Duran Duran's Taylor duo with Robert Palmer, all funk-rock guitars and thunderous drums.
picks.summary: Chic鼓手Tony Thompson的律动是全片核心，铜管与失真吉他交织，80年代录音室工艺范本。
picks.summaryEn: Tony Thompson's Chic-honed groove drives it all, brass and distorted guitars woven together — an 80s studio-craft benchmark.

picks.title: RAVEPOP
picks.artist: r u s s e l b u c k
picks.highlight: 把快乐硬核、Donk与Jersey Club搅成一锅高能糖水，献给通宵蹦迪的电子玩家。
picks.highlightEn: Happy hardcore, donk and Jersey club whipped into a high-energy sugar rush — made for all-night ravers.
picks.summary: 极度拼贴的网络世代电子美学，BPM与音色跳跃剧烈，风格辨识度远超其听众规模。
picks.summaryEn: A wildly collaged internet-era electronic aesthetic with jolting BPM and timbre shifts, far more distinctive than its listener count.

picks.title: Snow, Vol. 9
picks.highlight: 德国lo-fi嘻哈代表Wun Two《Snow》系列第九辑，温暖采样与雪夜律动，适合深夜书写。
picks.highlightEn: Wun Two's ninth Snow volume: warm samples and snow-night grooves, ideal for late-night writing sessions.
picks.summary: 器乐嘻哈的稳定输出，爵士采样与轻柔鼓点营造冬日氛围，系列粉丝基数庞大。
picks.summaryEn: Steady instrumental hip hop: jazzy samples and soft drums conjure winter atmosphere for a large, loyal following.

picks.title: Monument
picks.highlight: 德国哥特金属老兵Crematory新作，厚重失真与阴冷旋律交织，德式金属的仪式感。
picks.highlightEn: German gothic metal veterans Crematory return: thick distortion braided with cold melody and Teutonic ritual weight.
picks.summary: 乐队三十余年风格延续，双吉他对位与低吼人声兼具攻击性与旋律性，完成度高。
picks.summaryEn: Three decades into their career, twin-guitar counterpoint and growls balance aggression with melody at a high level of craft.

picks.title: The Great Adventure
picks.highlight: 瑞士舞曲天王DJ BoBo回归，欧陆舞曲与流行旋律的狂欢派对，适合全家一起摇摆。
picks.highlightEn: Swiss dance-pop king DJ BoBo returns with a Eurodance party of big hooks — the whole family can move to this.
picks.summary: 90年代欧陆舞曲标志人物的新专辑，明亮合成器与合唱副歌，怀旧又适合节庆场合。
picks.summaryEn: New work from a 90s Eurodance icon: bright synths and singalong choruses, nostalgic and made for festive occasions.

picks.title: Big Cock
picks.highlight: 英国psychobilly怪杰King Kurt重出江湖，Rockabilly低音贝斯与疯狂派对气息十足。
picks.highlightEn: British psychobilly eccentrics King Kurt return, all slap-back bass and gleeful party mayhem.
picks.summary: 精神病比利小众分支的代表声音，摇滚比利节奏混合夸张表演感，猎奇而有趣。
picks.summaryEn: A representative of psychobilly's cult fringe: rockabilly rhythms fused with theatrical excess, weird and fun.

picks.title: Nothing Hurts Like Everything
picks.highlight: 来自加拿大的Ourson以同名专辑铺陈细腻情绪，旋律与留白之间藏着治愈的力量。
picks.highlightEn: Canada's Ourson builds quiet tension on this record — healing tucked into the space between melody and silence.
picks.summary: 低曝光但情绪浓度高的创作，编曲克制、人声贴近，适合独自深夜聆听。
picks.summaryEn: Low-profile but emotionally dense songwriting: restrained arrangements and intimate vocals, best heard alone at night.

picks.title: Von Abseits
picks.highlight: 德国嘻哈老牌Doppelkopf新专辑，德语押韵与松弛律动，唱出边缘视角的城市观察。
picks.highlightEn: German hip-hop veterans Doppelkopf return with German-language rhymes and laid-back grooves — city life seen from the margins.
picks.summary: 德语说唱场景的资深组合，歌词叙事性强，展现德国本土嘻哈文化的另一面。
picks.summaryEn: Long-standing voices in German rap: narrative-driven lyrics that reveal a lesser-heard side of German hip-hop culture.

picks.title: Appalachia
picks.highlight: Emily Scott Robinson回到阿巴拉契亚山区，民谣叙事与乡愁嗓音，像一部短篇小说集。
picks.highlightEn: Emily Scott Robinson returns to Appalachia: folk storytelling and homesick vocals that read like a short-story collection.
picks.summary: 美国民谣创作者的地域书写，吉他与人声为主，歌词细腻，叙事完成度极高。
picks.summaryEn: Regional songwriting from an American folk artist: guitar-and-voice arrangements with precise, novelistic lyrics.

picks.title: The Lighthouse Session II
picks.highlight: 丹麦厄运金属名团Saturnus《灯塔录音室》第二辑，缓慢沉重的旋律与哀悼之美。
picks.highlightEn: Saturnus's second Lighthouse Session: slow, heavy melodies and a beauty that borders on mourning.
picks.summary: 现场录音版本保留长音铺陈与死亡厄运的悲怆感，适合喜欢氛围与沉重旋律的听众。
picks.summaryEn: A session recording preserving long-form build-ups and death-doom pathos — for fans of atmosphere and crushing melody.

picks.title: Unity
picks.highlight: 荷兰鞭挞金属乐队Pariah回归，急速riff与硬核冲击，献给老派thrash乐迷。
picks.highlightEn: Dutch thrashers Pariah return with rapid-fire riffs and hardcore impact — a gift to old-school thrash fans.
picks.summary: 荷兰地下金属场景的代表声音，节奏凌厉、结构紧凑，保留八九十年代鞭挞的原始快感。
picks.summaryEn: A voice from the Dutch underground: razor rhythms and tight structures keeping the raw 80s/90s thrash thrill alive.

picks.title: Eingenordet
picks.highlight: 德国中世纪民谣摇滚Versengold新作，手风琴、风笛与合唱，酒馆里的一场狂欢。
picks.highlightEn: Germany's Versengold deliver hurdy-gurdy folk rock full of accordion, pipes and tavern singalongs.
picks.summary: 德语民谣摇滚的场景代表，中世纪乐器与现代乐队编制结合，现场感与在地文化色彩强烈。
picks.summaryEn: Leading lights of German folk rock, merging medieval instruments with a modern band setup — strongly local and live-feeling.

picks.title: 崩坏3-于未来彼端回眸-Original Soundtrack
